findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "demo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: holding, chart_values, recent_trades · Private data: get_core · Public sink: events, get_trade_plan, trade_candidates · Destructive: get_trade_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: holding, chart_values, recent_trades · Private data: get_core · Public sink: events, get_trade_plan, trade_candidates · Destructive: get_trade_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
